sharedReasoning: Read all27 complete supplied Chinese units s0461–s0487. The opening 初 is a flashback through earlier travel; the seven-year stay lacks a dated calendar start. The handover precedes the explicit 咸和八年 arrival (AD333). 九年 resumes the Xianhe sequence after the arrival, while 建興二十一年 is separately identified as Zhang Jun’s nonconforming local era usage. 後 and 自後 tie subsequent own actions and reception events to that narrative floor, without naming exact years. 有年 and 經世 inside the memorial do not define a numeric Western interval. The closing 永和元年 dates Chonghua’s separate appointment; it must not be copied as the current memorial/mission year. No historical office tenure, ruler lifespan or external death year is imported.
